newsitem.title: THAILAND: King Bhumibol swears in new Thai government.
newsitem.headline: King Bhumibol swears in new Thai government.

text.p: Thailand's King Bhumibol Adulyadej on Sunday officially swore in Chavalit Yongchaiyudh and his cabinet as the nation's new government.
Chavalit, Thailand's 22nd prime minister who also holds the defece portfolio, will hold his first cabinet meeting on Monday, sources from his six-party coalition government said.
The cabinet, which was previously approved and appointed by the King on Friday, were sworn in at an official ceremony at the palace on Sunday evening.

Chavalit's New Aspiration Party won a slim two-seat victory over its rival Democrat Party in a November 17 general election and became the core of a six-party coalition that holds 221 seats in the 393-seat lower house.
Chavalit replaces Banharn Silpa-archa who dissolved parliament in September after a bruising no-confidence debate where he and his Chart Thai party were accused of mismanagement and corruption.
Key members of the NAP-led cabinet include Snoh Thienthong as interior minister and unelected specialists Amnuay Viravan and Narongchai Akrasanee as finance and commerce minister, respectively.
Chavalit has said his government's top priority is to improve the nation's slowing economy.
